question: In what duration (in years) will ₹7,200 fetch a simple interest of ₹360 at 4% per annum rate of interest?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

⇒ SI = (P × R × T) / 100

⇒ T = (SI × 100) ÷ (P × R)

⇒ T = (360 × 100) ÷ (7200 × 4)

⇒ T = 36000 ÷ 28800 = 1.25

**∴ Answer = 1.25 years**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

⇒ Principal (P) = 7200

⇒ Simple Interest (SI) = 360

⇒ Rate (R) = 4%

**Formula:**

⇒ SI = (P × R × T) / 100

**Calculations:**

⇒ 360 = (7200 × 4 × T) / 100

⇒ 360 = (28800 × T) / 100

⇒ 360 = 288T

⇒ T = 360 ÷ 288 = 1.25

**∴ Final Answer: 1.25 years**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

**Simple Interest Formula:** SI = (P × R × T) / 100

**Time Formula:** T = (SI × 100) ÷ (P × R)

**Unit Rule:** Rate is always per annum unless specified.

**Shortcut Tip:** Cancel zeros early to simplify calculation quickly.
